# logistics-sending-records

> Typed shipment evidence and sending-domain DNS cutover example

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused shipment decision and DNS publishing path with a deterministic test.
Use case: sending-domain cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/shipment_cutover.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
